author: Ankit
problem: Read N distinct points with IDs 1 to N. For each point, print the ID of the farthest other point by Euclidean distance; on ties, print the smallest ID.
bug_description: Uses dn < d instead of dn > d, so starting from d = 0 nothing is ever chosen and every line prints 0.

comments.accurate: For each point, prints the ID of the farthest point, smallest ID on ties
comments.wrong_behavior: For each point, keeps the candidate with the smallest squared distance, skipping the point itself
comments.wrong_location: Distance comparison verified; check the squared distance for negative coordinates
